environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service in us-east-1 VPC but all S3 traffic is forced through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f) with a custom endpoint policy. The VPC route tables have no NAT gateway route for S3 prefix lists (pl-63a5400a), so S3 is ONLY reachable via the VPCE. The endpoint policy document restricts PutObject to keys matching the condition s3:prefix with StringLike 'exports/default/*' and additionally requires s3:RequestObjectTag/origin to equal 'system-generated'. The task IAM role is unchanged. Subnet NACLs block outbound 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 except through the VPCE prefix list.

config.vpc: 10.0.0.0/16, no NAT for S3 prefix list pl-63a5400a
config.nacl: outbound 443 blocked to 0.0.0.0/0; only VPCE prefix list allowed
